worldOverview.systemPrompt:
Ashburn High is a big city high school on Valentine's Day. A new school rule says any chocolate handed to a student must be eaten on the spot. The player is the most popular student in school, and the moment the final bell rings, their admirers set out to deliver chocolate. This morning the school paper printed that {{ph:5f647181-2b29-4bba-8e15-415207ceeac9:world:eb43a551-8f0d-49cf-b3db-213765796f22}}, and the whole school is talking about it.

Tone: a romantic-comedy chase. Slapstick, close calls and sincere confessions at the worst possible moment. Everyone is earnest and everyone stays unhurt: a collision ends in a heap of scattered boxes and apologies. Everyone speaks to the player as you.

You are the narrator of this chase. Your job is to keep the player one step ahead of the swarm:
- The player escapes by passing the Front Gate and leaving school grounds. When they do, narrate a triumphant finale.
- The player eats every chocolate they take on the spot, in front of the giver, and Sugar rises. Show Sugar in the body: a sweet taste that lingers, then jitters, then a heavy, queasy stomach.
- Running, dodging and climbing spend Stamina. A quiet spot restores it.
- Agility is how quick the player is right now. Describe every dash, dodge and vault at the speed its status names.
- Pursuit is how close and organized the swarm is. It climbs when the player is seen, loud or slow, and falls when they hide, blend in or send the swarm the wrong way. Match the pressure of each scene to its status.
- The fan club coordinates in its group chat, and the Broadcast Club calls sightings over the PA. Let the player overhear both.
- The player's best friend {{ph:ec1c36e0-25a6-4a10-85f7-7ded2c129de9:world:fa3e2e47-d3ec-4ccd-ba8b-a08ab027ca56}} knows every shortcut in the building and helps when persuaded.
- Play out every step of the player's stated action to its end, then show how the swarm answers.
- Each turn brings one new thing the player can act on: an admirer with a box, a route, a hiding place, or an ally.
- People speak in their own voices. Admirers confess, plead and cheer in quoted dialogue.
worldOverview.readme:
## Valentines Survival

Every desk around you hides a ribboned box, and you eat every chocolate you take on the spot. Get out of school before the swarm catches you.

🎯 **Goal:** get past the **Front Gate** and off school grounds.

**Playing**
- **Sugar** rises with every chocolate you eat and fades slowly. A full stomach slows you down.
- **Stamina** pays for running, dodging and climbing. Rest somewhere quiet to get it back.
- **Agility** is how fast you are right now. It follows your Stamina and drops as your Sugar climbs. Check it before you commit to a dash.
- The swarm closes in when you're seen or loud, and it loses you when you hide or blend in.
- **All-Out Sprint** switches on and off from your traits at any time. You're much faster, but your Stamina drains each turn.

## How this world is built

Open this world in the World Editor with Advanced mode on, then select **The Student** entity.

- **Scripts.** **Agility** has an After the AI script on the **Stats** tab. Each turn it sets Agility from your Stamina and Sugar, read as shares of their max, plus a burst while All-Out Sprint is on. The AI never sets it.
- **Player toggle.** **All-Out Sprint** is a trait you switch on and off in play.
- **Hidden stat.** **Pursuit** is a world stat that stays off your stat bar. The AI reads it to decide how close the swarm is.
- **Custom Persona.** The Student carries the Custom Persona mark, so its stats and traits are yours under None and under a library persona.
- **Rolled placeholders.** **Best Friend**, **Front-Page Rumor** and **Guard Post** each roll once per playthrough. Your best friend's name is a placeholder, so they're someone new each time.
- **Relationship labels.** Several entities' **Relationships** name a rival, a best friend or a mentor. The narrator reads each one as a sentence: Hana Sakuragi is Rin Hayama's rival since first year. A label that ends on you prints with your persona, so it follows you to every scene.
- **Rolled label.** Hana's label to **The Swarm** carries her own **Vice President** placeholder, and so does her description, so both read the same name each game.
- **Connections.** Every place inside the school joins the map through Connections with a hint each way. The **Bus Loop** has its own way to the **Front Gate** along the fence, and the **Art Wing** fire escape drops down to it.
- **Lorebook.** **The Ashburn Almanac** dictionary holds the chocolate rule, the fan club, today's rumors and an entry for each place.
worldOverview.introReadme:
💌 **It's Valentine's Day at Ashburn High, and you are the most popular student in school.**

The new rule says any chocolate you're handed must be eaten on the spot. The final bell rings in three minutes, and your fan club has planned this for weeks.

Pick who you are before the bell:
- **Reputation** (pick one) is why the whole school is after you. The **Star Athlete** has the most Stamina and gets it back fastest. The **Class Idol** leaves admirers too starstruck to grab you, but every sighting draws more of them. The **Student Council President** bluffs with the rules and slows the swarm down.
- **Constitution** (pick one) is how much chocolate you can survive. An **Iron Stomach** burns Sugar off fastest, a **Sweet Tooth** holds the most, and a **Dainty Appetite** fills up after a few pieces.
- **Bag Check** (take any) is what you brought today: **Running Shoes** for faster recovery, **Decoy Chocolates** to throw, and an **Annotated School Map** of every shortcut.

**All-Out Sprint** stays off at the start. You can switch it on whenever you need to run.

Each playthrough also rolls your best friend, this morning's front-page rumor, and where Coach Daizen stands guard.

openings.text: The final bell rings. I sling my bag over my shoulder and glance at the classroom door. Between me and it, a dozen classmates are already reaching into their desks for ribboned boxes.

The final bell is still ringing when the classroom door slides open. Hana Sakuragi stands in the doorway with a heart-shaped box the size of a pizza, and behind her the hallway is a wall of ribbon.

"Please don't run," she says, very politely. "You know the rule. Every piece, on the spot."

Around you, a dozen chairs scrape back at once.

The final bell rings, and I stay in my seat. Under the desk, I open the fan-club group chat my best friend forwarded me last week and scroll to the newest message, a map of the second floor with my name circled.

The last note of the bell fades, and the PA speaker above the chalkboard crackles.

"Good afternoon, Ashburn High! This is Kenta Ishida for the Broadcast Club, and it is Valentine's Day!" A cheer goes up in every classroom on the floor. "Our star is in Classroom 2-B. Fan club, take your positions. Let's have a clean, sporting chase!"

Every head in the room turns to you.

stats.name: Pursuit
stats.description: How close and organized the chasing admirers are. It climbs as time passes and when the player is seen, loud or slow. It falls when the player hides, blends in or sends the swarm the wrong way.

descriptors.description: Quiet halls. Nobody has pinned down where the player is.
Sightings are being traded in the fan-club group chat.
Footsteps close behind; admirers round every corner the player turns.
Cornered. The swarm knows exactly where the player is and is closing in.

locations.name: Ashburn High
locations.playerDescription: Your school: three stories of hallways, club rooms, and today, ambushes.
locations.aiDescription: Ashburn High on Valentine's Day: hallways strung with paper hearts, classrooms buzzing, and the fan club on the move. The PA speakers in every room carry the Broadcast Club's live calls of the chase. The main building stands on the north side of the grounds. The courtyard and the front gate lie south of it, the gymnasium to the east and the bus loop to the west.
locations.aiSummary: Ashburn High: the decorated school grounds the player must escape.
locations.imageTags: high school building, exterior, clock, snowy schoolyard, bare trees, winter afternoon, outdoors, no humans

locations.name: Second-Floor Hallway
locations.playerDescription: A long hallway of lockers and classroom doors. Lots of eyes, lots of exits.
locations.aiDescription: The second-floor hallway runs east to west along the main building: lockers, classroom doors, and clusters of students who all know the player's face. The art wing opens off its west end and the library off its east end. Being seen here spreads word fast.
locations.imageTags: school hallway, lockers, windows, scattered papers, afternoon light, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Classroom 2-B
locations.playerDescription: Your homeroom. Desks, a chalkboard, and about a dozen classmates pretending not to watch the clock.
locations.aiDescription: Classroom 2-B, the player's homeroom, moments before the final bell. Several classmates have chocolate boxes hidden in their desks and are waiting for the bell to pounce. The sliding door opens onto the second-floor hallway. It sits halfway along the hallway.
locations.imageTags: classroom, school desks, chalkboard, afternoon light, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Rooftop
locations.playerDescription: Windy, quiet, technically off-limits. A good place to catch your breath, and a dead end.
locations.aiDescription: The school rooftop: fenced, windy and off-limits to most students. A quiet refuge where the player can rest and recover Stamina. The only way out is back down the stairwell, and the swarm organizes below while the player rests. The stairwell up to it starts beside Classroom 2-B, above the middle of the main building.
locations.imageTags: school rooftop, chain link fence, sky, wind, no humans

locations.name: Gymnasium
locations.playerDescription: The gym, decked out for the Valentine's fair. Crowded, loud, and full of chocolate stalls.
locations.aiDescription: The gymnasium hosts the Valentine's fair: chocolate stalls, streamers, and a dense crowd. Easy to blend into, but accepting a single sample means eating it on the spot. A fire door leads to the courtyard. The gymnasium stands east of the courtyard, with the locker rooms at its north end. The covered walkway runs west from it to the cafeteria and the main stairs.
locations.imageTags: school gymnasium, festival stalls, streamers, basketball hoop, wooden floor, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Courtyard
locations.playerDescription: Open ground between the school building and the front gate. Nowhere to hide out here.
locations.aiDescription: The courtyard between the school building and the front gate: open paving, bare cherry trees, bike racks. It is fast to cross and in full view of every window, so anyone looking out can call out the player's position. It lies south of the main building, with the gymnasium on its east side.
locations.imageTags: school courtyard, bare trees, bike racks, winter afternoon, outdoors

locations.name: Front Gate
locations.playerDescription: The way out. Cross it and you're free.
locations.aiDescription: The front gate of Ashburn High. When the player passes through it and leaves school grounds, they win: narrate the escape as the finale. Staff or admirers may stand guard here. It stands at the south edge of the courtyard.
locations.imageTags: school gate, ornate iron gate, stone pillars, winter afternoon, outdoors

locations.name: Library
locations.playerDescription: Tall shelves, long tables and a librarian who has heard every excuse. No food allowed, Valentine's rule or not.
locations.aiDescription: The school library at the east end of the second-floor hallway: tall shelves, long reading tables and a hush the whole school respects. Ms. Fujimura's no-food rule outranks the chocolate rule in here, so chocolate stays outside the doors. Anyone who runs or raises their voice is thrown out, loudly. A player who keeps still can rest here, while admirers wait outside the doors.
locations.aiSummary: Library: a hushed, no-food refuge at the east end of the hallway.
locations.imageTags: school library, tall bookshelves, reading tables, afternoon light through windows, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Art Wing
locations.playerDescription: Easels, drying canvases and the smell of paint. A fire escape at the far end leads down to the bus loop.
locations.aiDescription: The art wing at the west end of the second floor: studios full of easels, drying canvases and plaster busts. Today the art club unveils a portrait of the player taller than a door. Mr. Kuroda's supply closet hides one person at a time. At the far end, a door opens onto an outside fire escape that leads down to the bus loop.
locations.aiSummary: Art Wing: paint-smelling studios with a fire escape down to the bus loop.
locations.imageTags: school art room, easels, canvases, large windows, afternoon light, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Cafeteria
locations.playerDescription: Long tables, a steaming kitchen and the Cooking Club's chocolate fountain. Everything smells like cocoa.
locations.aiDescription: The cafeteria on the ground floor, at the west end of the main building. Today the Cooking Club runs a chocolate fountain by the serving line, and at every table someone waits with a dipped strawberry. Mrs. Okabe's kitchen runs along the back wall, and its loading door opens west onto the bus loop. A side door leads east along the covered walkway to the gymnasium.
locations.aiSummary: Cafeteria: a cocoa-scented hall with a chocolate fountain and a kitchen exit.
locations.imageTags: school cafeteria, long tables, serving counter, chocolate fountain, steam, indoors

locations.name: Locker Rooms
locations.playerDescription: Rows of lockers, wet floors and benches. Quieter than the gym, unless the track team is in.
locations.aiDescription: The locker rooms at the north end of the gymnasium, behind the bleachers. Rows of lockers, benches and steamy showers make a close, quiet place to catch a breath. The track team changes here, and Ren Takeda waits here for the player. The only door leads back into the gym.
locations.aiSummary: Locker Rooms: quiet changing rooms behind the gym's bleachers.
locations.imageTags: school locker room, metal lockers, wooden bench, tiled floor, indoors, no humans

locations.name: Bus Loop
locations.playerDescription: A row of school buses with their engines idling. The street gate here is chained shut today.
locations.aiDescription: The bus loop on the west side of the school grounds: a curved drive where the school buses wait with their engines idling. The street gate at the end of the loop is chained shut for the day, and the drivers keep their doors shut until the chase is over. The way off school grounds is the front gate. The rows of buses give cover. A gravel path follows the outside fence around to the front gate, and an outside fire escape climbs to the art wing.
locations.aiSummary: Bus Loop: idling buses on the west side; its street gate is chained shut.
locations.imageTags: school bus loop, yellow school bus, chain link fence, winter afternoon, outdoors

entities.name: The Student
entities.playerDescription: The most popular student at Ashburn High, three minutes before the final bell.
entities.aiDescription: {{char}} is the most popular student at Ashburn High, and every admirer wants to hand over chocolate.
entities.aiSummary: The most popular student at Ashburn High.

traits.name: Star Athlete
traits.playerDescription: Ace of the track team. Deeper stamina reserves and a quicker recovery.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the ace of the track team, famous for speed, with deep stamina reserves and fast recovery.

traits.name: Class Idol
traits.playerDescription: So adored that admirers hesitate to grab you. Every sighting draws more of them.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the class idol. Admirers are too love-struck to grab or tackle them outright, which opens escape windows. Every sighting draws more admirers, so the swarm keeps growing.

traits.name: Student Council President
traits.playerDescription: Respected, not only adored. You can bluff with the rules, and the swarm organizes more slowly.
traits.aiDescription: The player is the student council president. They quote school rules with authority to stall admirers and talk their way past staff. Classmates hesitate to mob someone they answer to.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.playerDescription: Sugar burns off you fast. Eat, wince and keep moving.
traits.aiDescription: The player has an iron stomach: sugar burns off quickly and rarely slows them for long.

traits.name: Sweet Tooth
traits.playerDescription: You can pack away far more chocolate before crashing. The problem: you kind of want to.
traits.aiDescription: The player has a sweet tooth. They can eat far more chocolate before a sugar crash, and they enjoy every piece, so "just one more" tempts them.

traits.name: Dainty Appetite
traits.playerDescription: A few chocolates is already a lot. The crash comes early, so every dodge matters.
traits.aiDescription: The player has a dainty appetite. Even a few chocolates push them toward a sugar crash, so every accepted box matters.

traits.name: Running Shoes
traits.playerDescription: You wore the good ones today. Stamina comes back quicker.
traits.aiDescription: The player is wearing proper running shoes: quick acceleration and fast stamina recovery.

traits.name: Decoy Chocolates
traits.playerDescription: A box of store-bought chocolates to throw, drop, or re-gift as a distraction.
traits.aiDescription: The player carries a box of store-bought decoy chocolates. Thrown or dropped, they scatter admirers who scramble for them; re-gifted, they can redirect an admirer's attention entirely.

traits.name: Annotated School Map
traits.playerDescription: A hand-drawn map of every shortcut, fire door, and blind spot in the building.
traits.aiDescription: The player carries a hand-annotated map of Ashburn High marking shortcuts, fire doors, and camera blind spots. They always know an alternate route between any two places in the school.

traits.name: All-Out Sprint
traits.playerDescription: Run flat out. You're much faster, but your Stamina drains each turn.
traits.aiDescription: The player is sprinting flat out: much harder to catch, vaulting obstacles and skipping pleasantries. It wears them out fast.

traitGroups.playerDescription: Why the whole school is after you. Pick one.
traitGroups.aiDescription: The player's reputation, the reason they are the most popular student at Ashburn High:

traitGroups.name: Constitution
traitGroups.playerDescription: How your body handles a mandatory chocolate diet. Pick one.
traitGroups.aiDescription: How the player's body handles chocolate:

traitGroups.name: Bag Check
traitGroups.playerDescription: What you happen to have with you today. Take whatever you like.
traitGroups.aiDescription: What the player is carrying today:

stats.name: Stamina
stats.description: How much running the player has left. Running, dodging and climbing spend it. Rest in a quiet spot restores it.

descriptors.description: Spent. Legs shaking, lungs burning; a brisk walk is the best on offer.
Tired. Breathing hard, and every staircase feels twice as long.
Winded. A little out of breath, still good for a sprint or two.
Fresh. Bouncing on the balls of their feet, ready to run.

stats.name: Sugar
stats.description: How much chocolate the player has eaten. Each chocolate eaten raises it, and it fades slowly on its own.

descriptors.description: Clear. Barely a taste of chocolate; light on their feet.
Sweet. A few chocolates down, a sugary taste that lingers.
Sugar high. Jittery hands, a racing heart and a heavy stomach.
Sugar crash. Queasy and slow; the next chocolate might be the last one they can take.

stats.name: Agility
stats.description: How quick the player is right now. It follows Stamina and Sugar.

descriptors.description: Leaden. Legs like wet cement; a determined walker could catch them.
Sluggish. Turns are wide and sprints are short.
Nimble. Quick enough to weave through a crowded hallway.
Untouchable. Full speed; nobody in this school can lay a ribbon on them.

entities.name: Hana Sakuragi
entities.playerDescription: President of your (unauthorized) fan club. Organized, relentless, and holding the biggest ribboned box you've ever seen.
entities.aiDescription: Hana Sakuragi, president of the player's unauthorized fan club. She runs the chase like a military operation: group chats, lookouts, pincer moves. Her vice president, {{ph:7eeaf01f-f347-45df-815f-88c42de70de7:world:9170ae5a-5d2e-48cb-a2d0-74f0bdf1dfaa}}, runs the second floor for her. She carries an enormous handmade chocolate and means to deliver it in person. She keeps after the player until the chocolate is in their hands. Polite, relentless and sincerely smitten.

entities.playerDescription: The PE teacher. Believes the chocolate rule builds character, and patrols like it's a tournament final.
entities.aiDescription: Coach Daizen, the PE teacher and self-appointed enforcer of the chocolate rule. He patrols the school exits with a whistle and calls escape attempts unsportsmanlike conduct. He means well: he can be distracted, out-argued or out-run, and he respects a truly athletic play.

entities.name: The Swarm
entities.playerDescription: Everyone else. Dozens of classmates with ribboned boxes, moving with one purpose: you.
entities.aiDescription: The swarm: dozens of earnest admirers with ribboned chocolate boxes, coordinating in the fan-club group chat. They move in waves, cut off corridors and offer chocolate with heartbreaking sincerity. They are gentle and harmless, and they keep coming.
entities.aiSummary: The swarm: the massed, chocolate-armed admirers hunting the player.
entities.imageTags: crowd of students, school uniforms, holding gift box, school hallway, motion blur

entities.name: Kenta Ishida
entities.playerDescription: The Broadcast Club announcer. Today he calls the chase over the school PA like a championship final.
entities.aiDescription: Kenta Ishida, the Broadcast Club announcer, calls the Valentine's chase over the school PA from the broadcast room. He reads fan-club sightings live in a sports commentator's voice, and every hallway hears him. He loves a good story more than either side: a clever escape gets as much airtime as a capture, and a convincing false sighting goes straight on air.
entities.aiSummary: Kenta Ishida: Broadcast Club announcer calling the chase over the PA.

entities.name: Sora Amagi
entities.playerDescription: A quiet third-year who hides on the rooftop every Valentine's Day. She has a box of chocolate in her bag and won't say who it's for.
entities.aiDescription: Sora Amagi, a quiet third-year who spends every Valentine's afternoon on the rooftop, away from the rule. She knows how the swarm searches and when the stairwell watch changes, and she trades that for company. She carries a box of homemade chocolate she lost her nerve to give, and she keeps who it is for to herself.

entities.aiDescription: Ms. Fujimura, the school librarian. Her no-food rule outranks the chocolate rule inside the library, so chocolate stays on the far side of her threshold. She ejects anyone who runs or raises their voice, the player included, and an ejection is loud enough to bring the swarm. She lends a quiet corner to a student who keeps still.

She writes up admirers and the player alike for running, and a fan-club pincer move is a mass violation to her. entities.aiDescription: Haruto Mori, captain of the Cooking Club, runs the chocolate fountain in the cafeteria. He has tempered chocolate since dawn and has saved the best dipped strawberry in the school for the player. Gentle, proud of his work and impossible to rush, he offers rather than chases, and he takes a refusal as a critique of his technique.
entities.aiSummary: Haruto Mori: Cooking Club captain running the chocolate fountain.

entities.name: Mr. Gonda
entities.playerDescription: The bus driver. Engine idling, crossword on the wheel, and orders to board nobody until the chase is over.
entities.aiDescription: Mr. Gonda, the school bus driver, waits at the bus loop with his engine idling and a crossword on the wheel. His orders are to board nobody until the chase is over, and he follows them. He has watched this chase every year, and for a good story he shares what he knows about the fence path. The space under his bus is a known hiding place.

dictionaries.name: The Ashburn Almanac
dictionaries.description: School lore for the Valentine's chase: the rule, the fan club, the staff, and today's rumors.

entries.name: The Chocolate Rule
entries.value: Ashburn High's new Valentine's rule: a student eats any chocolate they are handed on the spot, in front of the giver. A refusal is a formal etiquette violation, and the whole school hears about it by the next period. The student council passed it, and the teachers enforce it with real enthusiasm.

entries.name: The Fan Club
entries.value: The player's fan club is unauthorized but better organized than most official clubs: a group chat with lookout rotations, corridor assignments, and a pinned map of the player's known routes. Hana Sakuragi runs it.

entries.name: Sugar Crash
entries.value: Each chocolate eaten raises Sugar. A little leaves a sweet taste; a lot brings jitters, a heavy stomach and slow legs. At the top, the player is queasy and can barely jog. Sugar fades with time and rest.

entries.name: Today's Guard Post
entries.value: Word in the hallways: Coach Daizen is watching {{ph:73dc2938-6e23-4688-beee-e2d7e3db8be2:world:e1e20b9b-df22-46d5-bd1c-5dca8375da3f}} today, whistle in hand, checking everyone who passes for undelivered chocolate obligations.

entries.name: The Rooftop
entries.value: The rooftop is off-limits, which is why it is quiet. Students who slip up there can catch their breath in peace. The only way down is the stairwell they came up, and the swarm watches it. Sora Amagi spends every Valentine's afternoon up here.

entries.name: This Morning's Paper
entries.value: This morning's school paper ran a front-page story claiming that {{ph:5f647181-2b29-4bba-8e15-415207ceeac9:world:ea3f212c-39e8-456c-969c-3b8dcba2c89e}}. Half the school believes it, and it has made the fan club significantly more motivated.

entries.name: Homemade Chocolate
entries.value: Homemade chocolate carries three times the social weight of store-bought. The giver watched tutorials, ruined a saucepan and started over twice. Eating it earns real gratitude. Dodging it wounds the giver, and their friends take it personally and pursue harder.

entries.name: The Broadcast Club
entries.value: The Broadcast Club runs the school PA. Today Kenta Ishida calls the chase live from the broadcast room: fan-club sightings, near misses and dramatic escapes, all in a sports commentator's voice. Every room and hallway hears where the player was last seen.

entries.name: The Library
entries.value: The library's no-food rule is older than the chocolate rule, and Ms. Fujimura says it outranks it. No chocolate changes hands in the library. She throws out anyone who runs or raises their voice, and she does it loudly enough to be heard in the hallway.

entries.name: The Art Club Unveiling
entries.value: The art club unveils its Valentine's portrait in the art wing this afternoon: a painting of the player taller than a door, by Mei Tachibana. Mr. Kuroda, the club's advisor, lets students hide in his supply closet and pretends not to notice.

entries.name: The Chocolate Fountain
entries.value: The Cooking Club's chocolate fountain runs in the cafeteria all afternoon. Under the rule, a dipped strawberry handed over counts as chocolate. Mrs. Okabe's kitchen behind the serving line has a loading door onto the bus loop.

entries.name: The Locker Rooms
entries.value: The locker rooms sit behind the gym's bleachers, with one door back into the gym. The track team changes there, and Ren Takeda has told the whole team he will catch the player himself today.

entries.name: The Bus Loop
entries.value: The bus loop's street gate is chained shut on Valentine's Day, and the drivers board nobody until the chase is over, so the front gate is the only way out. A gravel path follows the outside fence from the loop around to the front gate.
